summary: DEPT® is international company providing digital solutions, founded in 2015. Type: private company. About 4,804 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 89% of its 9 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 7 about growth or hiring; 5 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

culture.text: Values are 'Better together, Relentlessly curious, Get sh*t done', with employee communities DEPT/PRIDE, DEPT/MOSAIC and DEPT/WOMEN.
Half tech, half marketing, working for clients like Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay and OpenAI.
Staff study marketing, computer science, communication and design, from schools including University of Mumbai, Buenos Aires, UvA and Amsterdam UAS.

open.text: Dept Creative & Media B.V. and Dept Holding B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.

growth.text: Now has 4,000+ specialists, with about 4,804 people on LinkedIn.
Developing a multi-year brand concept for Dutch insurer Univé.

worth_knowing.text: Certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.
Its deputy CFO expanded outsourcing rather than waiting for AI to take over that work.
